# Frameflow Film

> Turn a product brief into a finished ad video through the AI Video Platform API.
> Agents submit jobs, humans approve paid generation, then agents poll until delivered.

## Entry point for agents

- [Agent onboarding (start here)](https://silentgenesislab.github.io/frameflow-film-skill/agent.md): auth, order, poll, approval rules, error codes, costs
- [Human guide](https://silentgenesislab.github.io/frameflow-film-skill/): installation and end-to-end walkthrough

## API

- Base URL: https://aivideo.sligenai.cn
- OpenAPI: https://aivideo.sligenai.cn/api/v1/openapi.json
- Full contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SilentGenesisLab/frameflow-film-skill/main/frameflow-film/references/api.md

## Skill and CLI

- Skill definition: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SilentGenesisLab/frameflow-film-skill/main/frameflow-film/SKILL.md
- CLI source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SilentGenesisLab/frameflow-film-skill/main/frameflow-film/scripts/film.py
- Download bundle: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SilentGenesisLab/frameflow-film-skill/main/dist/frameflow-film-skill.zip
- Repository: https://github.com/SilentGenesisLab/frameflow-film-skill

## Rules

- An Agent Key with read + write + generate is required. Ask a human for it.
- Never approve a job. Approval is a human action and returns 403 for Agent Keys.
- Ordering and storyboarding are free; paid generation starts only after human approval.
- HTTP 402 means insufficient credits: stop and ask an administrator.
